intro.uz: Bu — pochta boʻlimidagi eʼlon. Oʻqishdan oldin: pochtada nimalar qilish mumkin? Ish vaqti va qoidalarga eʼtibor bering.

paragraphs.en: Welcome to the Chilonzor Post Office! We are open from Monday to Saturday, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. We are closed on Sunday.
paragraphs.uz: Chilonzor pochta boʻlimiga xush kelibsiz! Biz dushanbadan shanbagacha, ertalab soat 9 dan kechki 6 gacha ishlaymiz. Yakshanba kuni yopiqmiz.

paragraphs.en: Here you can send letters and parcels to all cities in Uzbekistan and to other countries. You can also buy stamps, envelopes and postcards.
paragraphs.uz: Bu yerda Oʻzbekistonning barcha shaharlariga va boshqa mamlakatlarga xat va posilka yuborishingiz mumkin. Shuningdek, marka, konvert va otkritka sotib olishingiz mumkin.

paragraphs.en: Do you want to send a parcel? Please write the address clearly. Don't put food or water in your parcel. Take big parcels to Window 3.
paragraphs.uz: Posilka yubormoqchimisiz? Iltimos, manzilni aniq yozing. Posilkangizga oziq-ovqat yoki suv solmang. Katta posilkalarni 3-darchaga olib boring.

paragraphs.en: Do you have a question? Ask our staff at Window 1. Please wait in line. Thank you!
paragraphs.uz: Savolingiz bormi? 1-darchadagi xodimlarimizdan soʻrang. Iltimos, navbatda turing. Rahmat!
